description: Sends the follow-up mail with the replay and the offer to the people who watched long enough to see the offer and have not bought yet. Take it a day or two after a webinar: "Send the replay to everyone who stayed till the offer and did not buy." It needs the session, the webinar and a clear yes from you, and it reaches up to 200 people. Read the numbers first and say how many will receive it, because those people cannot be un-mailed. Nothing else changes on the campaign. For one email to one address there is a separate tool. Side effect: it acts on your connected WordPress site; nothing else is touched. Words hosts use: follow-up email, send replay, nobody bought, hot leads, follow up after webinar

confirm.description: Must be true, set only after the host said that this segment may be mailed.

session_id.description: From an earlier turn (weiter · texte · stand).

site.description: Which connected site is meant when this chat has more than one: the address exactly as wi_get_connector_status lists it under sites. Leave it out while only one site is connected.

webinar_id.description: The webinar (campaign) id, as wi_list_webinars returned it. Never invent an id.

name: wi_send_webinar_followup
